10.name: Tree cover
10.part3_implication: High clearing and compensatory afforestation cost; moderate terrain and environmental sensitivity

20.name: Shrubland
20.description: Woody perennial plants with persistent woody stems, height < 5m
20.part3_implication: Low clearing cost; standard construction difficulty

30.name: Grassland
30.description: Natural herbaceous vegetation without substantial tree or shrub cover
30.part3_implication: Minimal clearing cost; favorable for earthwork

40.name: Cropland
40.description: Cultivated agricultural land and harvested fields
40.part3_implication: Moderate to high agricultural land acquisition compensation

50.name: Built-up
50.description: Urban and built-up land, residential and commercial structures
50.part3_implication: Very high property acquisition and resettlement cost; strict corridor avoidance preferred

60.name: Bare / sparse vegetation
60.description: Lands with exposed soil, sand, rocks with vegetative cover < 10%
60.part3_implication: Zero land acquisition friction; potential geotechnical/slope stability review

70.name: Snow and ice
70.part3_implication: Extreme engineering hazard and maintenance burden; high routing friction

80.name: Permanent water bodies
80.description: Lakes, reservoirs, wide rivers, and coastal waters
80.part3_implication: Severe engineering constraint requiring major bridge or causeway infrastructure

90.name: Herbaceous wetland
90.description: Inundated or saturated marshlands and swamps
90.part3_implication: Strict ecological sensitivity and poor foundation soil bearing capacity

95.name: Mangroves
95.part3_implication: Statutory coastal regulation exclusion and high bridge foundation cost

100.name: Moss and lichen
100.description: High altitude or polar moss and lichen cover
